# filemanager_tfvars (Data Source)

Reads a Terraform `.tfvars` or `.tfvars.json` file and returns its parsed content as native dynamic types. Supports querying individual variables by name.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The path of the tfvars file to read.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Variable name to extract from the tfvars file. Returns the value of the specified variable.
- `service` (String) Service to use for file operations. Defaults to local filesystem.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The raw file content as a string.
- `data` (Dynamic) The parsed tfvars content as a dynamic Terraform value. Access individual variables using dot notation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data source.
- `md5` (String) MD5 checksum of the file content.
- `query_result` (Dynamic) Result of the query if specified. Returns the value of the queried variable as a dynamic type.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the file content.
- `size` (Number) Size of the file in bytes.
- `var_count` (Number) Number of top-level variables in the tfvars file.
- `var_names` (List of String) Sorted list of top-level variable names in the tfvars file.
